final: WITH description_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS description, AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS average_units, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS average_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON CAST(p.production_type_code AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(pc.production_type_code AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS overall_average FROM description_averages) SELECT AVG(d.average_units), AVG(d.average_difference), AVG(d.average_difference - o.overall_average) FROM description_averages AS d JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE d.average_difference > o.overall_average
